blocks.text: Tucked along the peaceful shores of Anda, Bohol, Solea Reef Resort offers an intimate coastal escape for couples, families, and travelers looking to step away from the demands of everyday life. Across its 4.1-hectare property, the resort brings together sea-facing accommodations, Filipino comfort food, and a natural setting that encourages guests to reconnect with the world beyond their screens. The ocean as everyone’s view At Solea Reef Resort, the sea is not reserved for a select few rooms. All accommodations face the ocean, making the view a defining feature of the guest experience.
